prompt: Why should fruit already lying on the path be left there?
promptZh: 為什麼掉在步道上的水果要留在原處？

options.text: To give the gardeners a chance to check its ripeness.
options.zh: 讓園藝志工有機會檢查是否成熟。
options.whyZh: 步道水果留下是為了標示掉落位置，不是看成熟度。

options.text: To remind households how many pears they have taken.
options.zh: 提醒每戶已拿了幾顆梨。
options.whyZh: 每戶上限只談摘附在枝上的梨，步道水果不是領取紀錄。

options.text: To show the maintenance crew where fruit is landing.
options.zh: 讓維護人員看到水果掉落的位置。
options.whyZh: 第二段直接說明留下步道水果是暫時提供落點資訊。

options.text: To make it easier to move them to the tray later.
options.whyZh: 通知只說完好的草地落果放盤，沒有規定將步道落果移到盤裡。

explanationZh: 第二段直接說明留下步道水果是暫時提供落點資訊。
evidence: a gardener is keeping those pieces there temporarily so the maintenance crew can see where fruit is landing.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: a gardener is keeping those pieces there temporarily so the maintenance crew can see where fruit is landing.

vocabulary.note: 指出水果放在步道並非長期安排。
